primary.name: Polygenic-score clumping+thresholding zeroes sub-threshold SNPs
primary.source: Choi, Mak & O'Reilly 2020, Nature Protocols (PRS tutorial)
primary.omitted: All SNPs below the p-value threshold (effects set to exactly 0 in the score)
primary.zero_treatment: Risk scores summed over retained SNPs only; sub-threshold SNP effects enter clinical models as zero
primary.known_fact: Standard PRS 'clumping and thresholding' discards sub-threshold variants. Choi et al. 2020 document the procedure as the field's workhorse.
primary.gap_statement: Millions of small effects are zeroed by threshold, then the score is used as if the zeroing were a measurement of no effect -- privileging the retained-SNP model in clinical prediction.

ranked.name: Polygenic-score clumping+thresholding zeroes sub-threshold SNPs
ranked.source: Choi, Mak & O'Reilly 2020, Nature Protocols (PRS tutorial)
ranked.omitted: All SNPs below the p-value threshold (effects set to exactly 0 in the score)
ranked.zero_treatment: Risk scores summed over retained SNPs only; sub-threshold SNP effects enter clinical models as zero
ranked.known_fact: Standard PRS 'clumping and thresholding' discards sub-threshold variants. Choi et al. 2020 document the procedure as the field's workhorse.
ranked.gap_statement: Millions of small effects are zeroed by threshold, then the score is used as if the zeroing were a measurement of no effect -- privileging the retained-SNP model in clinical prediction.

ranked.name: LASSO-zeroed coefficients reported as 'no effect'
ranked.source: Tibshirani 1996, J. Royal Stat. Soc. B (LASSO); Lee, Sun, Sun & Taylor 2016, Ann. Appl. Stat. (exact post-selection inference)
ranked.omitted: Coefficients shrunk to exactly zero by L1 penalty
ranked.zero_treatment: Zeroed predictors reported as having 'no effect'; naive CIs computed post-selection as if the model were pre-specified
ranked.known_fact: LASSO sets coefficients exactly to zero. Naive confidence intervals after selection are invalid -- the entire post-selection inference literature (Lee et al. 2016) exists because treating the selected model as pre-specified injects false certainty.
ranked.gap_statement: The zero is an omission by regularization, not a measurement of no effect. Downstream 'X has no effect' claims treat it as measured.
ranked.notes: PRIMARY CANDIDATE. PPC-dual: adding a phantom confounder absorbing the signal would be the PPC version of the same privilege.

ranked.name: Basel risk-weight buckets zero within-bucket variation
ranked.source: BIS Basel III framework (bis.org), standardized approach risk weights
ranked.omitted: Within-bucket exposure heterogeneity (all exposures in a band share one weight)
ranked.zero_treatment: Capital requirements computed as if every exposure in a bucket carried exactly the bucket weight; intra-bucket risk differences treated as zero
ranked.known_fact: The Basel standardized approach assigns fixed risk weights to exposure buckets (BIS). Bucketing is public regulatory machinery, not a model secret.
ranked.gap_statement: Regulatory capital is computed on bucketed weights as if measured; the zeroed within-bucket variation privileges the bucketed balance sheet.

ranked.name: Stepwise/AIC covariate dropping without selection uncertainty
ranked.source: Simmons, Nelson & Simonsohn 2011, Psych. Science (researcher degrees of freedom); Harrell 2015, Regression Modeling Strategies, Springer
ranked.omitted: Covariates dropped by stepwise/AIC selection
ranked.zero_treatment: Final model reported with standard errors as if the dropped covariates were known-absent; p-values computed on the selected model
ranked.known_fact: Researcher degrees of freedom include covariate dropping (Simmons et al. 2011). Harrell documents that stepwise selection invalidates reported p-values and CIs.
ranked.gap_statement: Dropped covariates are treated as measured-zero rather than as unmeasured; the surviving model's certainty is privileged by the omission.
ranked.notes: INFERENCE: the 'treated as measured-zero' reading of stepwise reporting is the TPC framing; the invalidity of post-selection p-values is sourced.

ranked.name: Fixed-effect meta-analysis sets between-study variance to zero
ranked.source: Borenstein, Hedges, Higgins & Rothstein 2009, Introduction to Meta-Analysis, Wiley
ranked.omitted: Between-study heterogeneity variance (tau-squared), fixed at 0 by model choice
ranked.zero_treatment: Pooled estimate and CI computed with tau^2 = 0 exactly; heterogeneity treated as measured-absent
ranked.known_fact: The fixed-effect model assumes one true effect (tau^2 = 0). Borenstein et al. document that applying it under heterogeneity understates uncertainty.
ranked.gap_statement: A modeling assumption (tau^2 = 0) is consumed downstream as a measurement of homogeneity; the pooled CI is privileged by the omission.
ranked.notes: Strongest G2 in catalog: the zero is literally in the equations.

ranked.name: Zero/mean imputation of missing values treated as observed
ranked.source: Little & Rubin, Statistical Analysis with Missing Data, Wiley (3rd ed. 2019)
ranked.omitted: The unobserved values (replaced by 0 or the mean)
ranked.zero_treatment: Imputed values enter regressions, variances, and CIs as if measured; standard errors shrink as if n were complete
ranked.known_fact: Little & Rubin document that single imputation (including mean/zero substitution) understates uncertainty; the imputed values are not data.
ranked.gap_statement: The omission (missingness) is papered with a constant, then the constant is treated as a measurement -- textbook truncation-privilege.

ranked.name: Non-significant results reported as 'no effect'
ranked.source: Altman & Bland 1995, BMJ ('Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence')
ranked.omitted: Unmeasured effect sizes in underpowered studies (the effect not detected)
ranked.zero_treatment: 'No significant difference' written and cited as 'no effect' -- the undetected effect enters the literature as zero
ranked.known_fact: Altman & Bland 1995: a non-significant result does not demonstrate no effect; absence of evidence is not evidence of absence. The misreading is endemic in medical reporting.
ranked.gap_statement: The omission (failure to detect) is converted into a positive zero-claim downstream; meta-analyses and guidelines inherit the false zero.
ranked.notes: Boundary case: the 'omission' is by underpowered design rather than explicit truncation; G1 holds weakly (dropping of the undetected). Kept as PENALIZED-leaning; engine decides.

ranked.name: NWP spectral truncation zeroes sub-grid modes in resolved dynamics
ranked.source: ECMWF IFS documentation (ecmwf.int), spectral truncation
ranked.omitted: Spherical-harmonic modes beyond the truncation wavenumber
ranked.zero_treatment: Resolved dynamics integrated as if truncated modes carry no energy; parameterizations stand in for the zeroed scales
ranked.known_fact: Operational NWP integrates the primitive equations at finite spectral truncation (ECMWF IFS docs); sub-grid processes are parameterized, not resolved.
ranked.gap_statement: The truncation zeroes small-scale modes in the resolved dynamics; the parameterized stand-in is treated as a measurement of those scales.
ranked.notes: INFERENCE: truncation + parameterization are documented; the 'stand-in as measurement' reading is the TPC framing.

ranked.name: EFT fits truncate at dimension-6; dim-8 Wilson coefficients set to zero
ranked.source: Burgess 2007, Ann. Rev. Nucl. Part. Sci. (EFT introduction)
ranked.omitted: Higher-dimension operators (dim-8+) in effective field theory fits
ranked.zero_treatment: Global fits quote bounds on dim-6 coefficients with dim-8+ set to zero exactly, as if measured-vanishing
ranked.known_fact: EFT organizes physics as a tower of operators suppressed by powers of (E/Lambda). Truncation at dim-6 is standard practice; Burgess 2007 reviews the framework.
ranked.gap_statement: The truncated tower is treated as complete; quoted bounds inherit certainty from coefficients that were never measured -- truncation-privilege on the dim-6 fit.
ranked.notes: INFERENCE: Burgess establishes the EFT tower; the 'bounds quoted as if complete' reading is the TPC framing of standard fitting practice.

ranked.name: Dichotomizing continuous predictors (median splits)
ranked.source: Royston, Altman & Sauerbrei 2006, Statistics in Medicine ('Dichotomizing continuous predictors... a bad idea')
ranked.omitted: Within-group variation of the continuous predictor (collapsed to 0/1)
ranked.zero_treatment: Group contrasts reported as if all members of a group share the group value; within-group gradients treated as zero
ranked.known_fact: Royston et al. 2006 demonstrate dichotomization loses power and biases estimates; it remains widespread in medical reporting.
ranked.gap_statement: Discretization zeroes the within-bin gradient, then the analysis proceeds as if the gradient were measured-absent -- a truncation-privilege on the binned model.

ranked.name: Dropped principal components in GWAS stratification correction
ranked.source: Price et al. 2006, Nature Genetics (EIGENSTRAT)
ranked.omitted: Higher principal components beyond the retained top-k
ranked.zero_treatment: Association statistics computed as if the dropped PCs contain no population structure (their contribution set to zero)
ranked.known_fact: EIGENSTRAT corrects stratification with top PCs. Residual stratification from unmodeled structure is a documented concern in GWAS.
ranked.gap_statement: The dropped PCs are treated as measured-empty of structure; any residual stratification is invisible to the corrected statistics, privileging the retained-k model.
ranked.notes: INFERENCE: Price et al. establish the top-k method; the 'dropped PCs as measured-empty' reading is the TPC framing.

ranked.name: Specification searching drops variables until results please
ranked.source: Leamer 1983, American Economic Review (Let's take the con out of econometrics)
ranked.omitted: Variables dropped across the unreported specification search
ranked.zero_treatment: The reported specification is presented as if the dropped variables were known-irrelevant; search path unreported
ranked.known_fact: Leamer 1983 is the canonical statement of specification-search bias in econometrics; reported models hide the search that selected them.
ranked.gap_statement: The search drops variables, then the surviving specification is treated as pre-specified -- the dropped variables' effects are zeroed by the search, not by data.

ranked.name: File-drawer problem: unpublished nulls omitted from the literature
ranked.source: Rosenthal 1979, Psychological Bulletin (the file drawer problem)
ranked.omitted: Unpublished null-result studies (missing from meta-analytic distributions)
ranked.zero_treatment: Published set treated as the whole evidence distribution; missing studies effectively zero-weighted as if confirmed-absent
ranked.known_fact: Rosenthal 1979 named the file-drawer problem: null results stay unpublished, biasing the published record. Publication bias is among the most replicated meta-scientific findings.
ranked.gap_statement: The literature omits nulls, then meta-analysis treats the truncated distribution as complete -- the omission privileges every published positive.
ranked.notes: INFERENCE: the 'zero-weighted as confirmed-absent' reading is the TPC framing; publication bias itself is sourced.

ranked.name: Lossy-compressed climate simulation data treated as exact downstream
ranked.source: Baker et al. 2016, Geoscientific Model Development (lossy compression on climate ensembles)
ranked.omitted: Sub-threshold floating-point detail discarded by lossy compressors
ranked.zero_treatment: Compressed fields used in ensemble statistics as if bit-exact; compression error treated as zero in downstream analyses
ranked.known_fact: Baker et al. 2016 evaluate lossy compression on climate simulation data; the paper exists precisely because treating compressed data as exact needed validation.
ranked.gap_statement: The compressor truncates information; downstream ensemble means/CIs proceed as if nothing was discarded -- the discarded detail is privileged-as-zero.

ranked.name: Main-effects ANOVA without interactions treats them as zero
ranked.source: Gelman 2005, Ann. Statistics (Analysis of variance -- why it is more important than ever)
ranked.omitted: Interaction terms not included in the ANOVA model
ranked.zero_treatment: Main effects interpreted as if interactions were measured-absent; tables report effects without interaction uncertainty
ranked.known_fact: Gelman 2005 argues ANOVA remains central and interactions are routinely under-modeled; omitted interactions bias main-effect interpretation.
ranked.gap_statement: The un-modeled interactions are zeroed by model choice, then main effects are read as if the zeroing were empirical.

ranked.name: Early stopping treated as convergence
ranked.source: Prechelt 1998, Neural Networks (early stopping -- but when?); Sjoberg & Ljung 1995 (early stopping as regularization)
ranked.omitted: The remaining optimization trajectory (un-taken gradient steps)
ranked.zero_treatment: Stopped weights reported and deployed as 'the trained model'; the truncation of training treated as if convergence were measured
ranked.known_fact: Early stopping is formally equivalent to L2 regularization (Sjoberg & Ljung 1995); Prechelt 1998 studies stopping criteria. The stopped point is not the optimum.
ranked.gap_statement: Training is truncated, then the truncated weights are treated as the solution -- the un-taken trajectory's contribution is zeroed by fiat.
ranked.notes: INFERENCE: the equivalence results are sourced; the 'treated as converged' reading is the TPC framing.

ranked.name: GW template-bank best match treated as the signal
ranked.source: Usman et al. 2016, Classical & Quantum Gravity (PyCBC search)
ranked.omitted: Off-bank waveform distance (the true signal is never exactly on the discrete bank)
ranked.zero_treatment: Detection statistic and parameter estimates reported at the best-match template; bank discreteness treated as zero error
ranked.known_fact: PyCBC uses a discrete template bank with a minimal-match criterion (Usman et al. 2016); no real signal lies exactly on a bank template.
ranked.gap_statement: The bank discretizes waveform space; the analysis proceeds as if the best template were the signal -- the off-bank distance is zeroed.
ranked.notes: INFERENCE: the bank/minimal-match machinery is sourced; the 'treated as zero error' reading is the TPC framing.

ranked.name: Tidal harmonic analysis drops unfitted constituents
ranked.source: Codiga 2011, URI/GSO Technical Report (UTide: Unified Tidal Analysis and Prediction)
ranked.omitted: Tidal constituents not in the fitted set (shallow-water and long-period residuals)
ranked.zero_treatment: Predictions generated from fitted constituents only; unfitted energy treated as zero in forecast error budgets
ranked.known_fact: UTide fits a selected constituent set (Codiga 2011). Any harmonic analysis leaves unfitted constituents in the residual.
ranked.gap_statement: The fitted set is treated as the tide; the unfitted constituents are zeroed in prediction rather than carried as uncertain.
ranked.notes: INFERENCE: UTide's constituent-set fitting is sourced; the forecast-error-budget reading is the TPC framing.

ranked.name: LSA truncated SVD: document similarity computed as if exact
ranked.source: Deerwester et al. 1990, J. American Soc. Information Science (latent semantic analysis)
ranked.omitted: Discarded singular values/vectors beyond rank k
ranked.zero_treatment: Cosine similarities in k-space reported and ranked as if the truncation introduced no error
ranked.known_fact: LSA truncates the term-document SVD to rank k (Deerwester et al. 1990); the method's value comes from the truncation, which is also its unadmitted error source.
ranked.gap_statement: The rank-k approximation is consumed as the semantic space itself; the discarded spectrum is treated as measured-zero rather than as approximation error.

ranked.name: HEALPix pixelization zeroes sub-pixel variation
ranked.source: Gorski et al. 2005, Astrophysical J. (HEALPix)
ranked.omitted: Sub-pixel sky variation within each HEALPix pixel
ranked.zero_treatment: Pixel values used in power-spectrum estimation as if uniform within the pixel; pixel-window treated as the full correction
ranked.known_fact: HEALPix discretizes the sphere into equal-area pixels (Gorski et al. 2005); sub-pixel structure is averaged away by construction.
ranked.gap_statement: Discretization zeroes intra-pixel gradients, then spectra are estimated as if the pixel value were a point measurement.
ranked.notes: Weakest real instance; kept to show the gate floor. Likely PENALIZED.

claim_hygiene: Research-stage classification. Not a physical discovery, not peer review, not a patent. Scores are a classification heuristic, not measurements of nature. Instances are textbook statistics; the class is the cross-realm named move plus the PPC-duality formalization, after archive subtraction. The seed README (2026-09-20) already declares TPC the dual of PPC; this buildout formalizes that declaration.
